entities.name: Ugrin Csák
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ugrin from the kindred Csák was a Hungarian prelate and military leader in the first half of the 13th century, who served as Archbishop of Kalocsa from 1219 until his death at the Battle of Mohi on 11 April 1241. He was also chancellor of the royal court from 1217 to 1219 and from 1230 to 1235.

entities.name: Ugrin Csák
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ugrin from the kindred Csák was a Hungarian prelate and military leader in the first half of the 13th century, who served as Archbishop of Kalocsa from 1219 until his death at the Battle of Mohi on 11 April 1241. He was also chancellor of the royal court from 1217 to 1219 and from 1230 to 1235.
